comment:
* Base interface to controlling a media transport.  This is the
 * interface for implementing things like on-screen controls: it
 * allows them to request changes in playback, retrieve the current
 * playback state, and monitor for changes to the playback state.

methods.name: public abstract void registerStateListener(TransportStateListener listener)
methods.comment: * Start listening to changes in playback state.

methods.name: public abstract void unregisterStateListener(TransportStateListener listener)
methods.comment: * Stop listening to changes in playback state.

methods.name: public abstract void startPlaying()
methods.comment: * Request that the player start its playback at its current position.

methods.name: public abstract void pausePlaying()
methods.comment: * Request that the player pause its playback and stay at its current position.

methods.name: public abstract void stopPlaying()
methods.comment:
* Request that the player stop its playback; it may clear its state in whatever
     * way is appropriate.

methods.name: public abstract long getDuration()
methods.comment: * Retrieve the total duration of the media stream, in milliseconds.

methods.name: public abstract long getCurrentPosition()
methods.comment: * Retrieve the current playback location in the media stream, in milliseconds.

methods.name: public abstract void seekTo(long pos)
methods.comment:
* Move to a new location in the media stream.
     * @param pos Position to move to, in milliseconds.

methods.name: public abstract boolean isPlaying()
methods.comment: * Return whether the player is currently playing its stream.

methods.name: public abstract int getBufferPercentage()
methods.comment:
* Retrieve amount, in percentage (0-100), that the media stream has been buffered
     * on to the local device.  Return 100 if the stream is always local.

methods.name: public abstract int getTransportControlFlags()
methods.comment:
* Retrieve the flags for the media transport control buttons that this transport supports.
     * Result is a combination of the following flags:
     *      {@link TransportMediator#FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_PREVIOUS},
     *      {@link TransportMediator#FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_REWIND},
     *      {@link TransportMediator#FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_PLAY},
     *      {@link TransportMediator#FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE},
     *      {@link TransportMediator#FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_PAUSE},
     *      {@link TransportMediator#FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_STOP},
     *      {@link TransportMediator#FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_FAST_FORWARD},
     *      {@link TransportMediator#FLAG_KEY_MEDIA_NEXT}
